name: Outdated Python requests (weak TLS defaults)
description: Python requests below 2.31.0 pins an older urllib3 with TLS verification weaknesses and proxy-Authorization leak bug (CVE-2023-32681).
rationale: Transport security libraries with known TLS or credential-leak flaws break NIST SC-8 (protected transmission) and IA-5 (authenticator management). PCI DSS 4.2.1 requires strong cryptography; 8.3.2 requires credentials not be exposed during transit.
